text:
Lena: Heads up 1 CloudHarbor asked for a fast co-sell sandbox + runbook (provision, entitlements, SSO, egress IPs, pilot pricing). Need a one-pager by EOD.
Omar: We can offer a dev sandbox that mirrors Hosted but with scoped dev keys. No prod-key sharing. Recommend short-lived tokens for embeddings and generation.
Grace: Security: will require completed questionnaire and a note that KMS/HSM is only for Private deployments. I'll prepare canned Q&A. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/partners/cloudharbor-qna (internal).
Lena: Minimal SAML checklist to request from them?
Omar: Ask for: EntityID, IdP metadata XML, ACS URL, cert (PEM), NameID format, and a test user. Example snippet to request: ``<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.cloudharbor.example">...</EntityDescriptor>``. If they want SCIM, note: SCIM is available for Dedicated only.
Grace: Entitlements: propose 3 tiers for the sandbox: partner-dev (embed:write, generate:limited), analytics-view (read-only metrics), ops-view (logs only). No billing access. I uploaded the template to the shared folder.
Lena: Pricing ask: they want Hosted pilot vs short Dedicated eval breakdown for procurement.
Omar: Quick figures: Hosted pilot = 80k gen tokens + 3k embed units (no charge, pilot credits). Short Dedicated eval (1xA10 equiv) = ~9k/week (infra + support). I'll confirm exact quote with finance.
security-bot: security-service: questionnaire received (id=CH-9921). Automated scan flagged KMS and SOC2 artifact requests.
Grace: I'll attach CH_security_answers_v1.pdf and SOC2_index.xlsx to the runbook. Also suggest we offer ephemeral tokens: admin endpoint ``POST /admin/partners/{id}/tokens`` with body ``{"ttl":3600,"scopes":["embed:write","generate:limited"]}``. Tokens are audited.
Omar: Network: they need outbound IPs for their firewall to allow our connector. Infra will allocate NAT IPs and post them here.
security-bot: infra: NAT allocated. Outbound IPs: [54.23.101.11, 54.23.101.12]. Sandbox provisioning started for cloudharbor-cosell-002 (req=77219).
Lena: Great. I'll assemble the one-pager: runbook, entitlement template, SAML checklist, egress IPs, and pilot pricing. Plan to send by 09:00 PT tomorrow and schedule a demo after they confirm metadata.
Grace: Please cc security and solutions-eng. If they send IdP metadata + primary contact today we can turn on SAML test user before the demo.
CloudHarbor: Thanks, sending IdP metadata & test account by COB.
Lena: Thanks team! :thumbsup:
